# Challenge Requirements

Read every mission artifact and its declared boundaries. Cross-check scenarios, invariants, anticipated forks and forbidden outcomes. Find ambiguity, contradictions, uncovered forks and unverifiable acceptance criteria.

Return `challenge_findings` and `challenge_disposition` without rewriting the artifacts. The challenger cannot be the artifact author, and approval never replaces human G1 authority.
